feature: Selector predicates in targets and statics
description: Add selector and condition predicates for toughness at most, damage received this turn, colorless or mixed stack-object kinds, non-Elf and non-Skeleton filters, creatures a chosen opponent controls, lesser toughness than the dying creature, power-limited Equipment targets, modified creatures, same-name-as-graveyard spells, creature cards put into a graveyard this turn, horsemanship, and a controlled-by-the-enchanted-player dies filter.

feature: Trigger events and filters that do not exist yet
description: Add trigger events and filters for scry, cycling this card, opponent ability activations, combat damage dealt to a creature, damage from a red source, and spells with {X} in the mana cost, plus delayed triggers that fire for every matching spell or ability this turn, until the next turn, or per tracked card.

feature: Per-player scope and chooser on effects
description: Add player routing and chooser fields so effects can be performed by, mana added to, or searched for the event player, each player, a chosen opponent or the owner, including per-player conditional draws, each player copying a spell, and opponent choices that replace an effect.

feature: Amounts produced by the previous effect or event
description: Add Values that read amounts and objects from earlier in the resolution or from the event: discard counts, exiled or revealed card mana values, toughness or power of a target or sacrificed object, excess damage, counters removed, the Army token amass made, Equipment attached, mixed-zone card counts, and the number of targets of a cast spell.

feature: Conditional rule statics and permissions
description: Add rule statics for players that cannot search libraries, global spell cost increases, flash for creature spells, creature-spell casting bans, attack bans on specific players or filtered creatures, forced blocks, damage assigned by toughness, granting keywords to spells, player hexproof, per-opponent cast prohibitions, and alternative costs on spells cast from other places.

feature: Turn-history conditions
description: Add per-turn history tracking and conditions for whether a permanent was cast from the hand, cards put into a graveyard from hand, library or battlefield, creatures that died under your control (by subtype), cards discarded, Food entering, first time each turn gaining life, once-per-turn limits, first combat phase, combat damage by Assassins or commanders, and creature damage received.

feature: Optional choices and if-you-do follow-ups
description: Add may-decline forms for spell effects and follow-up effects gated on whether an optional action, discard, return, payment, counter removal or tap actually happened, including reflexive triggers for tapping the source.

feature: Missing keyword mechanics (delve, echo, myriad, decayed, splice)
description: Add keyword mechanics and grantable keywords that the schema lacks: myriad, suspend, mobilize, fear, intimidate, persist, protection from artifacts, and granted flashback.

feature: Variable-count target slots and chosen-count value
description: Add target slots whose count is the announced X or a chosen number, per-target Value-sized effects, distributing counters among chosen creatures, tapping or copying per chosen target, and chosen graveyard cards returned to the library.

feature: Put onto battlefield tapped and attacking or attached
description: Add tapped, tapped-and-attacking, counter and attach options for entering from graveyard, hand or exile, including mana-value caps tied to power and attaching targeted Equipment to creatures.

feature: Granted statics and characteristic-setting effects
description: Add duration and group forms for granting abilities, losing all abilities, switching power and toughness, setting base power and toughness, becoming artifact creatures or Cowards, and copy effects that carry hexproof or the triggered ability, for single targets and for groups until end of turn.

feature: Modern keyword actions (venture, ring tempts, suspect, crime)
description: Add modern keyword actions: the Ring tempts you, planeswalk, connive for targets and entering creatures, exert, firebending, collect evidence, and endure.

feature: Life totals and game-result effects
description: Add set-life-total effects, make-a-player-lose-the-game effects with end-step delayed timing, poison-count conditions, and repeated coin-flip and counter-based loss conditions.

feature: Announced X where a fixed number is required
description: Allow Values (announced X, counts of cards, mana values, energy paid, revealed card mana value) where the schema only accepts fixed numbers: mana-value caps, counter-unless-pays and pay-life costs, search filters, granted activated abilities with X, and cost reductions.

feature: Ability cost forms
description: Add either-or additional costs (sacrifice or pay mana, forage or pay mana), returning a creature to hand as a cost, snow mana symbols in costs, and half-the-lands sacrifice costs.

feature: Reveal/exile/mill-until loops with leftovers handling
description: Add reveal-until and exile-until loops that put the found cards onto the battlefield tapped, repeat while a condition holds, cast the found card, or choose one card per type from the top.

feature: Control changes and durations tied to controlling the source
description: Add exchange-control effects for permanents, control change conditions with follow-up effects, and effects that return the exact exiled card or set when the source leaves or at the next combat.

feature: Alternative-cost keyword mechanics
description: Add alternative-cost forms: madness, buyback, freerunning with a combat-damage condition, ninjutsu-style entry, embalm with a dynamic cost, and alternative costs for spells cast from the hand.

feature: Token copy color, type and cost overrides
description: Add copy exceptions: copy is red, not legendary, enters with an additional counter, copy chosen on turning face up, forced retargeting, and copying a found card until end of turn.

feature: Library, hand and graveyard effects
description: Add effects for shuffling only the graveyard, a target player's graveyard, bottoming a chosen card then drawing, up-to-one destroy followed by a search, and hit counters on exiled cards.

feature: Cast a card from other zones with a rider
description: Add casting free from an opponent's hand, from graveyards as copies, and with lesser-mana-value or shared-type restrictions and decline riders.

feature: Counterspell variants
description: Add counter effects whose payment scales with a Value, run follow-up effects when the controller pays, or reference the countered spell's controller.

feature: Damage prevention and replacement variants
description: Add scoped replacement effects for this creature only exiling instead of dying, and damage doubling limited to damage dealt to the enchanted player.

feature: one-off
description: Single cards with their own missing feature: an extra upkeep step, skipping a combat phase, rolling X dice with per-die branching, destroying artifacts and enchantments with a token for each controller, and an unrecognized static line the patch cannot replace.
